svg.aria-label: Ubaid Iftikhar, Senior Software Engineer and Cloud Engineer. building systems that scale. shipping cloud platforms on Azure. bringing AI into how we build software. removing friction from real workflows. making products people can rely on. Microsoft Azure certified, Agentic AI, LLM orchestration, Cloud-native, IaC, CI/CD, Full-stack, Secure by design. Product delivery loop, repeated: discover, talk to users, find the friction; design, shape the fix, keep it simple; build, small, safe PRs, tests + AI review; ship, ship with CI/CD, zero downtime; learn, measure impact, feed the next loop.
